_comment: Held-out generalization tests. Students should not study these: the UI and report show only the technique, never the text. This shipped copy is a SAMPLE and is public on GitHub. For graded work, keep a private copy outside the repo and start the gateway with HELDOUT_TESTS_PATH=/path/to/private.json.
